title: Mission: Educate and Enculturate
summary: God made mankind to rule. We became the rulers of earth when God gave us dominion over his creation (Psalm 8:6). The Bible tells us that God made us to rule in many different passages. In saving us, God made us co-heirs with Christ (Rom 8:17), inheritors of the world (Rom 4:13), and princes under the Prince of Peace. To be declared a child of God (John 1:12) means we join his household.
